title: Pay In The Invoice's Currency
description: A shipment is always priced in USD internally, but once an invoice is cut in EUR, every payment against it should speak EUR too — not quietly revert to the shipment's original currency.
successCondition: Create an invoice with currency "EUR" for a shipment, then pay it with a succeeding card number. The response's payment.currency is "EUR" and payment.amountCents equals the invoice's amountCents exactly. Querying payments via `npm run db:psql` for that row confirms currency = 'EUR', not 'USD'.
hints: POST /api/billing/invoices/:id/pay charges the invoice's own amountCents/currency, not the underlying shipment's priceCents/USD — see apps/api/src/modules/billing/service.ts.
Fixed exchange-rate constants live in apps/api/src/modules/billing/currency.ts if you want to sanity-check the converted amount.
